children: Hercules Capital, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 investment income of $140.1 million, up 1.5% from a year earlier, while net income from operations fell 21.8% to $93.6 million and diluted EPS declined to $0.48 from $0.63.
Revenue was $140.1M, compared with $138.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 1.5%.
Net income was $93.6M, compared with $119.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (21.8%).
Diluted EPS was $0.48, compared with $0.63 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (23.8%).
Portfolio fair value increased to $4.85 billion from $4.47 billion at year-end, with debt investments accounting for most of the increase.
Net commitments reached $2.63 billion, up from $2.21 billion a year earlier, while net debt fundings rose to $1.41 billion.
Nine-month investment income grew to $430.8 million from $395.1 million, primarily as average loan balances increased.
At amortized cost, 99.6% of investments were performing. Floating-rate debt represented 97.9% of the debt portfolio and carried rate floors.
Assets under management grew 12.7% to $6.47 billion. Management said it would continue monitoring market conditions and liquidity while pursuing new investments.
